model: b0 + b1 a + b2 a^2 + b_male + b_smile smile + b_ipd log(ipd_px/120) + b_grey grey; a = (age-50)/10

source.what: Wikimedia Commons portraits of people whose Wikidata entries carry a birth date (P569), sex (P21) and an image (P18); age at the photo = the Commons file's DateTimeOriginal year - the birth year (+-1 y).
source.built: 2026-10-10, blockin3 (hifipushie); MediaPipe Face Landmarker points, agecues.cues on each picture
source.filters: frontal (|yaw|, |pitch| <= 15 deg), mouth closed (jawOpen <= 0.25), eyes open (blink <= 0.5), pupil distance >= 60 px, no glasses / non-photographs (labelled on contact sheets), ages 18-90
source.notes: Only these statistics ship; the pictures stay off the repository. Wikidata metadata is CC0; each picture's licence and author are listed in agestats_sources.json. Covariates: sex, smile (MediaPipe mouthSmile), log resolution, greyscale (old prints).
